query: INSERT INTO billing_subscription (org_id, paddle_subscription_id, paddle_customer_id, status, current_period_end, occurred_at, updated_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7) ON CONFLICT (org_id) DO UPDATE SET paddle_subscription_id = EXCLUDED.paddle_subscription_id, paddle_customer_id     = EXCLUDED.paddle_customer_id, status                 = EXCLUDED.status, current_period_end     = EXCLUDED.current_period_end, occurred_at            = EXCLUDED.occurred_at, updated_at             = EXCLUDED.updated_at WHERE EXCLUDED.occurred_at >= billing_subscription.occurred_at
